index.html, styles.css, and script.js, with no external dependencies.

Requirements:
- Heading: “Research Search”.
- A search input with a visible label and a Search button.
- A local sample dataset of 10 papers, each with a title, author,
  year, topic, and description. Clearly label the data as examples.
- Case-insensitive search across title, author, topic, and description.
- Search works with both the button and Enter key.
- An empty query shows all papers.
- Display the result count and a clear “No results found” message.
- Include a Clear button and a responsive, accessible layout.

This searches the local sample dataset; it does not search the internet.

Create search.test.cjs using Node’s built-in test runner. Test search
by title, author, and topic, case-insensitive matching, empty queries,
and queries with no matches. Also check that index.html links to
styles.css and script.js and contains the required controls.

Run:
node --test search.test.cjs
node --check script.js
final_response:
Implemented the research-paper search website:

- `index.html`: Accessible search controls, result count, clear button, and example-data notice.
- `styles.css`: Responsive desktop/mobile layout with accessible focus states.
- `script.js`: 10 sample papers and case-insensitive search across all requested fields.
- `search.test.cjs`: 8 tests covering search behavior and HTML requirements.

Verification passed:

- `node --test search.test.cjs`: 8/8 tests passed
- `node --check script.js`: Passed with no syntax errors
